purpose: Source map for rebuilding Fit-Core supplement AI knowledge base. Use as evidence routing material, not as user-facing medical advice.

notes: High-risk supplement answers must be rule/template driven before LLM polishing.
Unsupported ingredients should ask for product label, ingredient amount, medication list, and condition context.
Do not present supplement advice as diagnosis, treatment, prevention, or cure.
